_comment: Synthetic fallback-fingerprint collision vectors for Packet 8A. Items without platform IDs use the versioned fallback fingerprint. identical snippets in different threads must NOT collide; exact duplicates must dedupe.

cases.name: identical_snippet_different_thread_no_platform_id
cases.reason: different thread_id => different fallback fingerprint => distinct identities

cases.name: exact_duplicate_no_platform_id
cases.reason: same thread + sender + ts + content => same fingerprint => dedupe (not new twice)

cases.name: same_thread_different_content
cases.reason: thread identity wins even when preview is edited; the fallback fingerprint would differ, but the thread ID keeps the stable identity stable
